title: define large payload storage policy and external object storage boundary

files.role: large payload storage and external object storage boundary

criteria: The policy keeps 47.101.11.109 metadata-only and forbids large payload bytes under /srv/aios-mirror.
External object storage is defined as transport only, not trust.
Object references require immutable HTTPS, size, digest, manifest, signature, revocation, compatibility, and rollback hash bindings.
Installer object fetch remains quarantine-first and fail-closed before any install, activation, or rollback side effect.
The next task is RC7-030 multi-node canary approval packet projection.
